name: GFL Environmental Inc.

ads_ratio.source: Form 40-F cover (SEC filing, CIK 1780232): the securities registered and listed on the NYSE under symbol GFL are the company's subordinate voting shares themselves (company releases declare dividends 'for each outstanding subordinate voting share'; the same class trades on the TSX as GFL) — there is no depositary or ADS program, so the NYSE line is the share itself, not an ADS
ads_ratio.reason: Direct-listed foreign private issuer: one NYSE-traded GFL share is one subordinate voting share, so no ADS conversion applies; per-share figures and the traded price are on the same basis.

fx_conversion.source: frankfurter.app — ECB reference rates (closest business day to each period end)

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency CAD converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 40-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Form 40-F cover (SEC filing, CIK 1780232): the securities registered and listed on the NYSE under symbol GFL are the company's subordinate voting shares themselves (company releases declare dividends 'for each outstanding subordinate voting share'; the same class trades on the TSX as GFL) — there is no depositary or ADS program, so the NYSE line is the share itself, not an ADS) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Utilities sector — OE/capex DCF fits utilities names poorly; grade confidence low
LOW_OE_YIELD: base OE yield 0.1% — valuation rests almost entirely on growth; tier is fragile
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.5x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 317.6x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
